caption:
도쿄 신주쿠의 전통방식 이자카야, 로바타야키집입니다.

숯불 위에서 완벽히 구워내는 마스터의 손길이 돋보이며, 분위기마저 요리의 맛을 더하는데요. 비슷한 계열의 로바타야키 중에서 만족도가 높아서 추천드려요!

간장에 숯불 향을 더한 야끼오니기리에 이쿠라를 얹은 메뉴가 베스트. 바삭한 껍질과 촉촉한 속살이 일품인 생선 소금구이, 즙이 가득 고인 버섯구이 등 재료 본연의 맛을 살린 요리도 일품이에요.

caption:
How much do you pay for lunch? 🤑

For a workday lunch, in Japan people generally like to spend around ¥1000, or about $7. Delicious and affordable is a win for me 💪🏻

Places mentioned:

(1) Yamamoto’s Hamburg
(2) Matsunoya 
(3) Shinpachi Shokudo

All have multiple locations in Tokyo and some in other parts of Japan, too! 🇯🇵

#japan #japanesefood #budgettravel #cheapeats #lifeinjapan".
transcription: Here are three affordable yet delicious chain restaurants to get lunch at in Japan. First is Yamamoto's Hamburg. They specialize in tender and juicy Japanese hamburger steaks. I like to get the one with blue cheese inside. A meal will cost you as low as $10. Next is Matsunoya. You can get a freshly fried Tomkatsu here with rice and miso soup for literally $5. I can't resist the grated daikon topping. I love this place. Last is Shinpachi Shokudo, a salary man favorite. They specialize in charcoal grilled fish set meals that you can enjoy starting from just $7. I always get the grilled salmon, this place never misses.

caption:
CAN’T BELIEVE IT ACTUALLY WORKED…

The pokemon cafe is famously IMPOSSIBLE to get into, the online resos fill up 30 days in advance. 

Try going on a WEEKDAY EVENING, we went at 7pm and there were 3 openings for NO SHOWS. We were seated right away 😭

📍 pokemon cafe in shinsaibashi daimaru (1 Chome-7-1 Shinsaibashisuji, Osaka)

-

#japan #japantravel #japantrip #travelhack #pokemoncafe #pokemon #osaka #tokyo #hack #travel #japanstyle #viral #snorlax".
transcription: I was told that this character cafe is the hardest to book in all of Japan, so I tried this hack and got in with no reservation and no weight. This is the Pokemon Cafe in Japan and apparently reservations fill up 30 days in advance. We went on a weekday evening and looked at the chart for no shows. There were a couple openings, so we were seated right away. I ordered a custom design latte. You can pick any Pokemon as a latte art, and you even get to keep the cup as a souvenir. We also ordered the chicken teriyaki rice in a Snorlax plate, which you can also pay a little bit extra and keep. You can ask the staff when the Pikachu dance is scheduled for. It's definitely a highlight and check out the gift shop for exclusives.
